verdict.rationale: Filee's docs state it can repack or extract ZIP, 7Z, RAR, TAR, disk images and other archive formats with a bundled 7-Zip engine, and that presets can pack a batch into one ZIP. This directly covers extracting and repacking archives as a conversion. Missing for 10: detail on which archive formats can be written as repack targets (e.g. whether RAR output is possible), and independent or hands-on corroboration beyond a single vendor doc line.

support.subject: As a power user, archives (ZIP, 7z, RAR) extract and repack as part of a conversion

citations.quote: Repack or extract ZIP, 7Z, RAR, TAR, disk images and many more archive formats with the bundled 7-Zip engine, or pack any files into one ZIP.
